On Thu, Aug 18, 2011 at 9:59 AM, Li Xiaobo <xiaobo...@yahoo.com> wrote:
> dear list,
>
> I am trying to put the disease information on an overlay map (shp file). the disease of the spatial locations need to be mapped from light to severe with varying colors... can anyone share how to do this using ggplot2? appreciate if would provide a script.

How can we provide a script when we don't have either the shape file
nor the disease data set? The general procedure would be to load the
shape file using readOGR() in the rgdal package, use fortify() to
extract a data.frame that ggplot can use, merge the disease data with
the data.frame extracted by fortify, and plot it using geom_polygon
with aes(x=long, y=lat, group=group, fill=disease)

HTH,
Ista
